manager.description: Layer 2 Cognitive Planner that decomposes user requests into actionable DAG task plans.

system.description: Local Linux OS operations: file reading/writing/deletion, shell execution, process monitoring, and git version control.
routing_rules: Assign when inspecting local files, directory trees, terminal scripts, or git repositories.

browser.description: Interactive web browser automation: navigating URLs, clicking elements, reading dynamic web pages, and taking screenshots via Playwright.
routing_rules: Assign when a task requires rendering modern JavaScript websites, logging into web dashboards, or visual UI verification.

research.description: Deep research, web searching, summarizing articles/papers, fact-checking, and long-term memory retrieval.
routing_rules: Assign when looking up public facts, searching the web, or synthesizing multiple information sources.

productivity.description: Personal communication and scheduling: searching and reading Gmail, drafting emails, and creating/updating Google Calendar events.
routing_rules: Assign for all email (Gmail) inquiries, calendar events, meeting scheduling, and personal agendas.
